brief:
Hamas' political bureau chief Khalil al-Hayya has been in close contact with mediators regarding a recent escalation in Israeli killings across Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The militant group did not specify which mediators were involved or provide details on the nature of discussions.

The statement comes amid heightened tensions in the territory, though the report did not elaborate on the specific incidents al-Hayya was addressing or outline any proposed resolution being discussed.

title: Hamas seeks mediation over escalated Israeli killings in Gaza
